lblSTPT: The steerpoint being changed, by its number.
btnCancel: Closes the window; the steerpoint stays as it was.
lblelv: Elevation in feet; for a target, the ground's height above sea level.
mxtSTPT_elv: Elevation in feet; for a target, the ground's height above sea level.
lblelv2: Elevation in feet; for a target, the ground's height above sea level.
mxtSTPT_E: Longitude as degrees,minutes (127,05.456) or decimal degrees; where the theater's map is not known, feet east.
mxtSTPT_N: Latitude as degrees,minutes (37,24.123) or decimal degrees; where the theater's map is not known, feet north. 00,00.000 empties the point.
cboSTPT_NS: North or south of the equator (greyed when the position is in feet).
cboSTPT_EW: East or west of Greenwich (greyed when the position is in feet).
btnApply: Apply: checks the position is inside the theater and puts it on the DTC page. Counts in Save to DTC.
btnClear: Clear: position 00,00.000, elevation 0 and no action, so Apply empties the steerpoint.
cboAction: What the steerpoint is for (Nav, Target, CAP…). Precision makes the jet use this exact point instead of BMS's own; Apply offers to set it.
